notice: This file reports repository evidence and review state only. It is not the FASB Codification, tax advice, a CPA opinion, or a representation that GH Real Estate financial statements comply with US GAAP.

currentness.promotion_rule: An official publication alert remains a discovery candidate until a CPA or qualified reviewer verifies authorized source material, applicability, effective dates, transition, and implementation through a pull request.

consumer_policy.general_research: Use the approved topic map as a research index and verify exact authoritative requirements through authorized live access.
consumer_policy.material_gaap_assertions: Verify scope, definitions, recognition, measurement, derecognition, presentation, disclosure, transition, effective date, and private-company alternatives for the actual entity and reporting period.
consumer_policy.production_systems: Pin an approved release commit or tag; never alter books, policy, tax treatment, or automation from an unreviewed discovery result.
consumer_policy.degraded_state: If a source, review date, or applicability conclusion is unresolved, preserve the approved baseline and prohibit a current US GAAP assertion until reviewed.

known_limitations: The repository contains FASB topic locators and original GH analysis, not Codification text or a licensed substitute for authorized FASB research.
The topic registry does not establish that GH Real Estate is required to issue US GAAP financial statements.
Exact subtopics, paragraphs, effective dates, transition provisions, scope exceptions, and private-company alternatives remain transaction- and period-specific.
The monthly review workflow checks stored dates; a green date check does not prove that live FASB material was reviewed.
Federal, Kansas, and local tax forms, thresholds, elections, procedures, and effective dates are volatile and require tax-year-specific verification.

Accounting treatment depends on entity, reporting basis, signed agreements, lender requirements, transaction documents, placed-in-service facts, materiality, estimates, and elections not established by the registry.
Book accounting, federal tax, Kansas tax, lease treatment, and Zoho configuration are separate layers and must not be forced to match.
The chart of accounts and production Zoho configuration are not automatically updated or certified by the authority registry.
Repository binary attributes now protect PDFs in new checkouts; a pre-existing Windows working tree may still need a fresh checkout before local byte-hash validation matches the Git blob.
